map.活性（棉麻）、分散（涤纶）、酸性（丝毛尼龙）、颜料（多纤维通用）适用纤维不同，固: Reactive (cotton and linen), disperse (polyester), acid (silk, wool, nylon) and pigment (universal for mixed fibres) suit different fibres and use different fixation processes, so ink consumption and unit price differ.
map.按图案像素占比或经验目测；满地色接近 100%，稀疏线条可能低于 5%，影响墨耗: From the pixel share of the pattern or by visual estimate; solid fills approach 100% while sparse line work may be below 5%, which affects the accuracy of ink consumption estimates.
